title: Amiss external evidence
description: One producer's observations over an external plan's introduced destinations, consumed by `amiss external-assess`. Rows report what was observed, never verdicts; judgment is the engine's fixed policy. A row naming a destination the plan did not introduce, repeating one, or binding another plan invalidates the whole file rather than being skipped, and destinations the file does not cover stay unproven.

plan_payload_digest.description: The payload digest of the exact plan these observations answer.

producer.description: Who gathered the observations and under which of its versions.

ProbeRow.description: One HTTPS probe: the final status or the transport failure, exactly one of the two, and the final address when the probe was redirected.

method.description: The request method whose answer this row reports; a 404 refutes only under get.

status.description: The final HTTP status, absent when the transport failed first.

failure.description: The transport failure, absent when a status arrived.

final_destination.description: Where redirects ended, when that differs from the destination.

redirect_chain_permanent.description: Present only when every observed redirect hop was 301 or 308. This is evidence for a retarget suggestion, never an automatic edit.

checked_at.description: The producer's own observation instant; the engine never reads a clock, so staleness policy belongs to the producer's operator.

ForgeRow.description: One forge API verification of a destination the plan shaped: repository visibility first, then the opaque tail's resolution, admissible only when the repository was readable.

destination.description: The plan row's destination, byte-exact; the plan must have shaped it.

repository.description: What the API said about the repository itself; missing may be a private repository, so it never refutes.

tail.description: How the opaque tail resolved against the readable repository's refs, absent when the producer stopped at visibility.
